attributes.title: Shared layout
attributes.sample: {{#each tabs as |tab|}} {{/each}}

lesson.concept: One visual marker can travel between distinct nodes
lesson.why: The selected tab renders a marker with one shared layoutId. LayoutGroup scopes the relationship so the receiver can animate from the previous marker bounds even though selection creates a different node.
lesson.experiment: Switch between distant tabs quickly. Follow the marker and compare Jelly tab with Magnetic tab; the selected label updates immediately while the marker catches up.
lesson.pitfall: A shared layoutId is not a unique DOM id; reusing it across unrelated tab groups can create unintended matches.
lesson.combine: Combine with Presence when adding content panels that must remain mounted during their exits. The current demo isolates the marker itself.
